component.name: Yapper
component.summary: Unofficial desktop client for Yapper chat, voice and screen sharing

description.p: Yapper for Linux is an unofficial desktop client for the Yapper chat service. It wraps the Yapper web app in a native window so it behaves like a real desktop application instead of a browser tab.

ul.li: Chat, servers, voice channels and screen sharing
Desktop notifications and a system tray icon
System screen picker on Wayland and X11
Microphone and camera access handled in-app
Works on Debian, Ubuntu, Linux Mint, Fedora, Arch and more

description.p: This application is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Yapper. Yapper and its logo belong to their respective owners.
First release: chat, servers, voice, screen sharing, tray and notifications.
